title: Mike Vrabel: I don't have any reaction to Dianna Russini report

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Vrabel: I don't have any reaction to Dianna Russini report
sources.description: The Athletic published the findings of its internal review of Dianna Russini's reporting on Thursday, several months after the release of pictures that revealed her relationship with Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel.
